description: Cheapest active SKUs meeting a minimum spec, ranked by list price only (no sponsorship, no affiliate weighting), excl. VAT (VAT-inclusive plans are ranked after removing their stated VAT rate; rank.vat_basis says so). gpu and vps default to commitment=on-demand: spot, reserved, committed, dynamic and community-cloud prices are left out unless commitment says otherwise. category vps|gpu|llm; vcpu, ram_gb, disk_gb minimums; gpu model substring (e.g. H100; with a memory size such as A100-80GB the card must state exactly that memory); region 'eu' for EU-deployable; currency USD|EUR for the ranking. Each row carries verified_at, stale and source_url. coverage_gaps names the providers not read yet (for vps: Hetzner Cloud, Contabo), so a floor is never mistaken for the whole market.

commitment.description: gpu and vps only. Default on-demand: standing list prices with no term and no interruption. spot, reserved, commit, dynamic or community select those rows; any shows every commitment (each row carries extra.commitment).
commitment.title: Commitment

listing.description: Listing filter, default current: only plans on the provider's public price page or product API count. all includes catalog-only and vanished plans (each row carries listing_status).
listing.title: Listing

region.description: 'eu' for EU-deployable, or a provider region code
region.title: Region

name: cheapest_for_spec
title: Cheapest for a spec
